# WaterLevels.org

WaterLevels.org maps USGS monitoring locations and curated Bureau of Reclamation, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, National Weather Service (NWPS), and California Data Exchange Center gauges, presenting streamflow, water level, and temperature readings for streams, rivers, lakes, and reservoirs across the United States. Flood categories and stage thresholds come from the National Weather Service National Water Prediction Service (NWPS) when a match exists.

This is not an official USGS, USBR, USACE, NWS, or CDEC website.

## Pages

- / — homepage and station search
- /map — interactive map
- /alerts — Flood Alerts: gauges at or above NWS flood stage (not email subscriptions)
- /gauges/{state} — state directory (two-letter state code)
- /gauges/{state}/{site-number}-{slug} — station page
- /about — project mission
- /disclosures — data sources, caching, and limitations
- /faq — frequently asked questions
- /privacy, /terms, /aup, /contact

## Data and APIs

WaterLevels.org does not offer a public third-party data API. First-party `/api/*` endpoints are for the website itself and are not open for external use.

For programmatic access, use:

- USGS Water Data APIs: https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/
- USBR RISE API: https://data.usbr.gov/rise-api
- USACE CWMS Data API: https://cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data/
- NWPS API: https://api.water.noaa.gov/nwps/v1/docs/
- CDEC: https://cdec.water.ca.gov/

Machine-readable catalog: /.well-known/api-catalog
